mapper.select: SELECT t.*, (t.device_tmpl_name NOT LIKE 'MOCK\_%') AS isReal, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM point_template p WHERE p.device_tmpl_id = t.device_tmpl_id AND p.is_deleted = 0) AS pointCount FROM device_template t WHERE t.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY t.device_tmpl_id
SELECT t.*, (t.device_tmpl_name NOT LIKE 'MOCK\_%') AS isReal FROM device_template t ORDER BY t.device_tmpl_id
SELECT t.*, (t.device_tmpl_name NOT LIKE 'MOCK\_%') AS isReal FROM device_template t WHERE t.device_tmpl_id = #{deviceTmplId} AND t.is_deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO device_template (device_tmpl_name, n4_name, device_type, model, purpose, manufacturer, manu_date) VALUES (#{deviceTmplName}, #{n4Name}, #{deviceType}, #{model}, #{purpose}, #{manufacturer}, #{manuDate})
mapper.update: UPDATE device_template SET device_tmpl_name = #{deviceTmplName}, n4_name = #{n4Name}, device_type = #{deviceType}, model = #{model}, purpose = #{purpose}, manufacturer = #{manufacturer}, manu_date = #{manuDate} WHERE device_tmpl_id = #{deviceTmplId}
